summary: Iteration 5 final verification for TableTaap restaurant manager dashboard after SettingsSection.jsx lint fix. Backend pytest: 17/17 passing — auth (login 4321 / wrong PIN / signup-idempotent), settings GET/PUT with gst_rate+printer_type, categories CRUD (create/rename/delete), menu CRUD with availability, orders create+status update, /stats/today returns growth_7d {revenue,orders,completed,aov}, /pricing math (₹299 base + ₹50×tables + 18% GST = ₹1178.82 for 14 tables), /subscription GET/POST with trial dates, range validation (10–60) and payment method whitelist. Frontend Playwright: login → /manager OK with PIN 4321; sidebar nav-orders/tables/menu/sales/settings + Profile/Logout entries; Orders page shows Live Orders, TODAY SALES card with eye-toggle (data-testid revenue-toggle-orders) masking revenue as ₹••••, Last 7 days +100% growth chips on stat cards; Bill modal → 'Send via WhatsApp' button (data-testid bill-whatsapp-btn) opens wa.me via JS handler; Menu page → Add New Item with inline category management present; Sales page → AreaChart (3 area paths, no line-only) with Y-axis ticks ['0','5k','10k','15k','20k','25k','30k','35k'] matching the 5k step spec; growth % displayed; Settings loads and Save button present (lint regression OK); Theme toggle flips data-theme dark↔light and persists in localStorage tt_theme; Subscribe page (/subscribe) shows TableTaap Per-Table Pricing calculator (10–60 slider, default 14 → ₹1,178.82 incl GST, 14 QRs, 4-day FREE trial) — OLD 3-tier Core/Prime/Elite NOT visible.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iter 3: gst_rate cannot be cleared via API — body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) is used (good for partial updates) but RestaurantSettings round-trip on response can re-emit a numeric value if originally set. Functional but consider an explicit null→$unset path.

issues: No explicit 'Subscribe' link in sidebar — /subscribe is reachable only via direct URL or contextual entry points (e.g. trial banner / Settings). Review request lists Subscribe as a navigable tab; consider adding a sidebar entry.

Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' console warnings during initial render on tab switch (cards mount before parent container has measured). Chart renders correctly afterward; suggest adding minWidth/minHeight or explicit ResponsiveContainer aspect to silence warnings.
Carry-over: clock still appears to use lowercase am/pm in some locales (observed '07:04 PM' in this run — looks fine, but iter-3 noted lowercase). Worth double-checking across locales.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'Subscribe' link/icon to manager sidebar so users can reach the per-table pricing page without typing the URL.
(Optional) Fix Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings on Sales tab initial mount.
(Optional/iter-3 carryover) Allow PUT /api/settings to clear gst_rate when explicit null is sent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~765 lines — still within tolerable limits but approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/menu.py, routers/orders.py, routers/stats.py, routers/subscription.py for maintainability.
PIN is stored plaintext in MongoDB (db.settings.manager_profile.pin). Acceptable MVP, but should be bcrypt-hashed before any production use.

POST /api/auth/signup and /api/auth/login return tokens (mgr-<uuid>) but no other endpoint validates them — the API is effectively unauthenticated for all writes (menu/order/settings/subscription). Add a simple Depends bearer-token check.
POST /api/auth/recover-pin compares only last-7 digits of contact_number with no rate-limit. Trivially brute-forceable. Add an attempt counter / cooldown.

/api/stats/today does an in-memory Python sum/grouping over up to 5000 orders × 2 weeks per call — fine for MVP, but switch to Mongo aggregation pipeline before scale (and add an index on created_at).
Subscription deprecated SubscribeRequest model still exported but unused — remove dead code to avoid confusion.
All ~12 'Bill' buttons on Orders list mount per-row; consider lazy-rendering the BillModal only when triggered to reduce React tree size.
